description: Live positions of every SEPTA Regional Rail train currently running in the Philadelphia region — train number, line, destination, current and next stop, minutes late, and lat/lon. Answers "is my train late" and "where is train 456". Optionally filter to one line. Example: septa_train_view({ line: "Paoli/Thorndale" })

line.description: Optional Regional Rail line filter: Airport, Chestnut Hill East, Chestnut Hill West, Cynwyd, Fox Chase, Lansdale/Doylestown, Manayunk/Norristown, Media/Wawa, Paoli/Thorndale, Trenton, Warminster, West Trenton, Wilmington/Newark. Omit for all live trains.
